mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_jobs ( case_id, search_condition_id, recording_id, job_type, status, prompt_snapshot, exclusion_prompt_snapshot, search_start_snapshot, search_end_snapshot, search_area_snapshot, retry_count, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{caseId}, #{searchConditionId}, #{recordingId}, #{jobType}, #{status}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{exclusionPromptSnapshot}, #{searchStartSnapshot,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{searchEndSnapshot,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{searchAreaSnapshot}, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.sql: id, case_id, search_condition_id, recording_id, job_type, status, prompt_snapshot, exclusion_prompt_snapshot, search_start_snapshot, search_end_snapshot, search_area_snapshot, retry_count, error_message, requested_at, started_at, claimed_by, claim_expires_at, completed_at, lease_token_hash, result_model_key, result_payload, result_digest
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = #{workerId}, claim_expires_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND ( status = 'QUEUED' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS'
SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' FOR UPDATE

SELECT aj.id AS job_id, aj.case_id, aj.recording_id, r.camera_id, c.camera_code, c.camera_name, r.s3_key AS recording_object_key, aj.prompt_snapshot AS prompt, aj.exclusion_prompt_snapshot AS exclusion_prompt, aj.search_start_snapshot AS search_start, aj.search_end_snapshot AS search_end, aj.search_area_snapshot AS search_area, aj.retry_count + 1 AS attempt FROM analysis_jobs aj INNER JOIN recordings r ON r.id = aj.recording_id INNER JOIN cameras c ON c.id = r.camera_id WHERE aj.id = #{jobId} AND aj.case_id = #{caseId} AND aj.job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS'

SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND ( status = 'QUEUED' OR ( status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ) ORDER BY requested_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS'

SELECT FROM analysis_jobs WHERE job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY claim_expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', claimed_by = #{workerId}, lease_token_hash = #{leaseTokenHash}, claim_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND ( status = 'QUEUED' OR ( status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) )

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_model_key = #{resultModelKey}, result_payload = #{resultPayload}, result_digest = #{resultDigest}, completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), claim_expires_at = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId} AND lease_token_hash = #{leaseTokenHash} AND claim_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = #{nextStatus}, retry_count = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'QUEUED' THEN retry_count + 1 ELSE retry_count END, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'QUEUED' THEN NULL ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'FAILED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, claim_expires_at = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId} AND lease_token_hash = #{leaseTokenHash}

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = #{nextStatus}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'QUEUED' THEN NULL ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'FAILED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, claimed_by = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'QUEUED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = NULL, started_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, requested_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'FAILED'

UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), error_message = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND id = #{jobId} AND job_type = 'RECORDING_ANALYSIS' AND status = 'RUNNING'
